metadata.title: New Developments in Mathematics, Computing, the Sciences, and New Views of Computation
metadata.description:
A clean, searchable digital edition of a paper presented at the 1986 Computers and Mathematics Conference.

The scanned conference-paper PDF is the controlling historical version. An earlier Scribe source and bibliography were used to repair OCR errors; obvious typographical errors were corrected conservatively, while wording and historical terminology were otherwise preserved.
